title: Number of Changing Keys
sourceKind: search results citing the LeetCode statement and mirrors
summary: Count the positions where the user changed keys. A key change is using a key different from the last used key; case differences do not count.
officialConstraints: 1 <= s.length <= 100; s consists of English letters only.
visualizationNotes: Visualization accepts 1 to 100 characters, which matches the sourced constraint.
